messages.content:
Risk: Sharing IP/PI/confidential
Description: AI agents with unrestricted access to resources or databases or tools could potentially store and share PI/IP/confidential information with other tools or agents when performing their actions.
Concern: AI agents may share privileged information with other tools/agents. The act of sharing the information may result in harm for the model owner, user, or others. The harm can vary based on the type and details of the information shared. Without adequate oversight, these privacy incidents might overwhelm company resources.
Policy: Protected Health Information Handling

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001017: Agent — A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: portion of pathological body substance, Target, physical sign
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#TradeSecretDisclosure: Trade Secret Disclosure — Unauthorized revelation of confidential business information such as formulas, processes, customer lists, or proprietary methods that provide competitive advantage. [found by 2/2 queries]
  Siblings: Plagiarism, Trademark Violation, Copyright Infringement
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001379: Agent Capability — A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act.
  Siblings: Strength, Affordance, plan
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Agent: agent — something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000740: Resource — A Continuant that is owned by, in the possession of, or is otherwise controlled by an Agent such that it could be used by that Agent.
  Siblings: D-dimer (human), generically dependent continuant, independent continuant
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000040: material entity — An independent continuant that is spatially extended whose identity is independent of that of other entities and can be maintained through time. [from equivalence]
  Siblings: hydrogensulfite, ornithinium(1+), posterior sector of right lobe of liver

axes.rationale: The risk explicitly mentions 'AI agents' performing actions and potentially sharing information. This class directly represents the entity performing the action.
The risk concerns the sharing of confidential information, which aligns closely with the concept of 'Trade Secret Disclosure'. This class represents the information being shared.
